summary: Phase 1 multi-page React Router architecture validated end-to-end via Playwright. All 40 critical UI flows passed with zero console errors. Verified SPA navigation (Header NavLinks, logo, footer link groups, mobile drawer), all 23 routes render (Home, Catalogue + 3 subs, Special Offers + 3 subs, How It Works, Plans, About, Blog + slug, Contact, FAQ, 4 legal pages, 404), active orange nav highlight (rgb(242,92,5)) works, scroll-to-top on route change works, global Signup modal opens via header CTA on /catalogue and /contact and via page-shell-start-button on /plans, lead capture POST /api/leads returns 201 + signup-success-message renders, EN/KA language toggle changes nav labels (Home -> მთავარი) and /catalogue still renders after toggle, hero secondary CTAs route to /catalogue and /special-offers, WhatsApp FAB present across all routes, mobile menu opens, navigates and auto-closes drawer.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx scroll-to-top uses `'instant' in window` ternary; the check is incorrect (window does not have an 'instant' key — this always evaluates false). It still works because the fallback 'auto' is acceptable, but the intent of `behavior: 'instant'` is lost. Suggest passing `behavior: 'instant'` directly or just `{ top: 0 }`.

Footer link testids are derived from English labels via `s.label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-')`. When `t.footer.company`/`t.footer.explore` is in KA, the labels become Georgian and the testids will mutate (e.g. footer-company-ჩვენ-შესახებ-link). Recommend deriving testids from the route key (e.g. ROUTES.about.key) so they remain stable across languages.
Header.jsx uses two separate scroll listeners + StrictMode — fine in dev, but consider passive: true for the scroll listener for perf.
Some footer testids use derived English labels with apostrophes/spaces — currently OK but brittle. Consider a TID map per link.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_Phase1 lead inserted into MongoDB db.leads via POST /api/leads during signup flow test (status 201).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 router migration is complete and fully working. data-testids are stable in EN mode. If next iteration involves KA-localized testing of footer, note that footer link testids are derived from translated labels (see code-review comment 2).
